blurb: Founded in Germany in 1976, Hohmann Fine Art - known simply as HOHMANN - is a contemporary art gallery with locations in Palm Desert and Palm Springs, California.For five decades, under the same family ownership across two generations, we have worked with collectors, institutions, designers, and museums to place exceptional contemporary art in private and public collections worldwide.
